title: run record frontmatter (docs/runs/YYYY-MM-DD-<slug>.md)
$comment: Hestia 0042 (frontmatter-fact-ledger, crossing agent-slack 0022). The supervisor writes `waves:` (supervise skill); 0042 adds a round's `cause` and a run's `findings:`. The laptop indexer checks a run record against this schema and writes the facts `wave` (key run, wave), `round` (key run, card, kind, start) and `finding` (key run, n, n being the finding's 1-based place in findings); a record that fails is a counted warning and gives no fact (its text is still a kb document). Owner: Hephaistos. New fields are optional, so run records written before 0042 stay valid. `reason` and `what` are one line of text, kept and never counted. The cause enum is the same in round.cause, finding.kind and the spec schema's amendment cause. A file named TEMPLATE*.md is a template, not a record, and is not checked.

findings.description: NEW (0042, Q-g): what the run found and was not asked, each with its kind and whom it went to

time.description: RFC 3339 with an offset, minutes enough (2026-10-26T02:00-03:00); anything else (older prose such as `in progress`) is valid, kept as written and read as no time

cause.description: the cause enum (0042 Q5, Hephaistos): why a round was needed, what kind of thing a finding is, why a spec was amended

oneOf.description: approach or context: the way chosen, or the context the seat was given, was wrong or missing
execution: the way was right, the work was not (a bug, an unmet gate item, a slip)
gate or spec: the gate or the spec asked the wrong thing, or was unclear
environment or process: rebase, conflict, usage limit, tooling, CI, machine, protocol
not known when written; never guessed

kind.description: build, review or take, as written

result.description: pass, fail or n/a, as written

cause.description: NEW (0042, Q-b): why this round was needed. Written on a review that fails and on a build that answers a failed review or redoes work (rebase, limit); left out of a first build and a first review.

to.description: whom it went to: a seat, a cell's FSE, hephaistos, pablo

card.description: the card it was found in or placed as, by slug

what.description: one line, kept and never counted
